tiers.note: Stable through PS1. NDS and Neo Geo CD are too heavy for 128MB RAM, so left off.
Stable through PS1. NDS and Neo Geo CD are too heavy for the entry-level chip, so left off along with N64, Dreamcast, Saturn and PSP.
Stable through PS1 and NDS. N64, Dreamcast, Saturn and PSP are inconsistent on the H700, so left off.
Solid through PS1, NDS, N64, Dreamcast and PSP. Saturn is inconsistent, and GameCube, Wii, 3DS, PS2 and Switch are too heavy, so left off.
Full speed through N64, Dreamcast and Saturn; PSP at 2-3x. GameCube and Wii are selective, PS2 needs tuning on heavy titles, and Switch is at the chipset limit, so all left off.
Strong through PSP, Dreamcast and Saturn. GameCube and PS2 included but game-dependent. Wii, 3DS and Switch are game-dependent, so left off.
Snapdragon 865. Full speed through Dreamcast, Saturn and PSP; GameCube, Wii, 3DS and PS2 included (heavy PS2 titles need tuning). Switch is compromised and Wii U and PS3 are unplayable, so left off.
Full speed through Dreamcast and Saturn; PSP at 4x. GameCube, Wii, 3DS and PS2 included. Switch included but game-dependent. Wii U and PS3 are compromised, so left off.
Everything through the 6th generation, plus Wii, 3DS, Switch, Vita and Wii U, runs on the Zen 2 / RDNA 2 APU. PS3 and Xbox 360 are game-dependent.
A desktop PC runs every system; RetroBat uses the ES-DE folder names.
